plugins.name: aws-lambda
plugins.description: Deploy to AWS Lambda with SAM behind the Lambda Web Adapter — one overlay for every language, built by ap-build; a deploy proxy in your account for credentials without keys; readiness checks before a deploy; CloudFormation stacks and functions as tools
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: tool: aws, sam (bundled as Python packages when not on PATH), ap-build (on the platform's worker and in the build images)
env: AWS_REGION; credentials from proxy_url (the deploy proxy in your account, no keys), role_arn (OIDC, no keys) or the AWS CLI chain (SSO, profile, instance role)
net: *.amazonaws.com, the proxy url when set

plugins.name: dokploy
plugins.description: Deploy to Dokploy: the CI publishes a Docker image on every release and the platform points the Dokploy application at that tag — one overlay for every language on the images-base build and runtime images; readiness checks (settings, image published, key accepted, application state); projects, applications and deployments as tools
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: env: DOKPLOY_URL, DOKPLOY_API_KEY on a machine (the plugin's url and api_key options on the platform); AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_USERNAME and AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_PASSWORD for a private image
net: the Dokploy instance's url; the image registry (ghcr.io by default)

plugins.name: example
plugins.description: Template plugin: a tool, a command, a deploy target with readiness, an overlay, a release strategy, stricter git-flow
plugins.author: actionplatform
